name: Kneeling Shin Stretch
steps: Kneel gently on a padded mat with your knees together and the tops of your feet resting flat behind you.
Lower your glutes slowly back to sit comfortably onto your heels with your torso upright.
Place your hands lightly behind you on the floor and lean gently back until you feel a smooth stretch across your shins and ankles.
Hold calmly with steady breaths for the target duration before shifting forward smoothly onto your hands to release.
tips: Keep your heels pointed straight back rather than letting your ankles sickle sharply inward or outward.
Place a rolled towel beneath your ankles or stay upright if deep ankle plantarflexion feels uncomfortable.
